name: color_splash
description: Color all elements of one category in the active view by the value of a parameter: each distinct value gets its own solid-fill override color (deterministic 20-color palette plus generated hues). Instance parameter is checked first, then type; valueless elements group under 'None'. Set reset=true to clear the overrides for the category instead. Returns per-value counts and RGB. Simplified port of mcp-servers-for-revit color_splash (gradient/custom color lists dropped).

params.name: category
params.description: Category name whose elements get colored, e.g. 'Walls', 'Doors', 'Rooms'. Matched case-insensitively against the document's category names.

params.name: parameter_name
params.description: Name of the parameter to group by (instance parameter first, then type parameter), e.g. 'Mark', 'Comments', 'Fire Rating'. Required unless reset is true.

params.name: reset
params.description: If true, clear the graphic overrides of the category's elements in the active view instead of coloring them.
